description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide two storey detached dwelling with habitable roof space; Landscaping, Bin and cycle stores
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England)  Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Arboricultural Report and Tree Survey for Proposed Replacement Dwelling at 26 Fallowfield, Stanmore, HA7 3DF (Ref. 1224-100840 Rev 2); PART D Local Biodiversity Checklists; Preliminary Ecological Appraisal Including a Protected Species Assessment at 26 Fallowfield, Stanmore, HA7 3DF; P375 Design and Access Statement Fallowfield, Middlesex REV 01; P375_GA_0.00; P375_GA_0.01; P375_GA_0.02; P375_GA_0.03; P375_GA_1.00; P375_GA_1.01; P375_GA_2.00; P375_GA_2.01 Rev A; P375_MS_0.00; P375_MS_0.01; P375_MS_1.00; P375_MS_1.01; P375_SP_0.00; P375_SP_0.01; P375_TP_0.00; Planning Statement (Ref. 2025_25); Planning and Heritage Statement (Ref. 2025_25).

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost. Details of those to be retained, together with measures for their protection in the course of the development, shall also be submitted and approved, and carried out in accordance with such approval, prior to any demolition or any other site works, and retained until the development is completed.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not proceed above the damp proof course level until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of:</p><p><br></p><p>(a) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the replacement dwelling</p><p>(b) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the ground surfacing</p><p>(c) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the boundary treatment, including side gates and fencing railings (if required)&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed&nbsp;in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

The windows, rooflights and doors in the elevation of the proposed development  facing towards 27 Fallowfield shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>Notwithstanding the submitted details, the development hereby permitted shall not progress above damp proof course level, until details of a bat box and a bird box, including specification and location of the boxes shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and details and prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works, full details of proposed rooflights with elevation and section drawings showing the rooflights to be flush to the roof plane shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>No construction works shall take place, including demolition, until a Construction Method Statement and Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. It shall provide for:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development&nbsp;</p><p>b) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;&nbsp;</p><p>c) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;</p><p>d) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;&nbsp;</p><p>e) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and&nbsp;</p><p>f) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the construction period.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the following information about the green roof has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Its location, extent, specification (plant species and soil depth), time of planting, watering and frequency of watering, landscape integration, integration with other roof plant or renewable energy infrastructure, structural integrity, construction, operation, and access.&nbsp;</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Section/profile drawings showing the soil depth, different build up layers, materials and membranes.</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Plans to clearly show its location, extent, drainage, inlets, and outflows.</p><p>d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Maintenance plan to show how it will be maintained regularly, maintenance considerations due to other roof infrastructure and any changes in maintenance throughout the seasons.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the green roof details as so approved and shall thereafter be maintained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details and prior to the commencement of development (other than works of demolition), full details of the permeable paving and details relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than works of demolition) until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Surface Water Drainage Strategy</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Disposal of Surface Water</p><p>c) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Disposal of Sewage</p><p>d) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Surface Water Attenuation and Storage</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted details of authority the location of a secure and sheltered cycle store, including the dimensions and external finish of the store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the following:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken.</p><p>d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works.</p><p>The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.</p>
<p>The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage area as shown on the approved plans.</p>
